{{Quote|My friend. Welcome to Moenia. The starport is a bustling center of commerce and community. And the swamp is an endless source of adventure.|[[Bertos Goodner]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BG">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=conversation|Bertos Goodner|Naboo}}</ref>}}
The '''Paitnnu Wetlands''' were a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The city of [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]] was located here.<ref name="SWG" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Paitnnu Wetlands was the location of a [[Imperial vs. Gungan Battle|battle]] between [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces.<ref name="SWG:IvGB">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=poi|Imperial vs. Gungan Battle|Naboo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Paitnnu Wetlands is one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
